title: North Providence Planning Board moves November meeting to the 10th

North Providence Planning Board moves November meeting to the 10th
The board shifted its regular session because Nov. 11 is Veterans Day and Town Hall will be closed that day.
The North Providence Planning Board voted Tuesday, Oct. 14, at Town Hall council chambers to move its regular November meeting from Nov. 11 to Tuesday, Nov. 10, because the original date falls on Veterans Day.
TOWN HALL CLOSED Board members noted that Town Hall would be closed on Nov. 11, forcing a change of date. "So we can't have it on the 11th," a board member said.
SCHEDULING CONFLICTS Board members weighed several alternate dates, including Nov. 12, Nov. 18 and Nov. 19, but ran into conflicts. One member said, "I'm holding a special zoning board meeting" on the 12th, and another noted a personal conflict, saying, "I'm not free the 19th just for the board's consideration."
Attorney Jack McGreen, representing the applicant for the Beard Avenue project, said he had no issue with either remaining option, telling the board, "I'm free the 10th. I'm also free the 18th."
THE VOTE After confirming there was no town council conflict on Nov. 10, the board made a motion to continue the Beard Avenue matter to that date. The motion, made by Mr. Rich Telly and seconded by Mr. Patassi, passed on a voice vote. The Beard Avenue agenda item was continued to the newly scheduled planning board meeting of Tuesday, Nov. 10, at 6 p.m.
